name: Tool — Web search (Bing grounding)
summary: BingGroundingTool / WebSearchTool inside a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed.
description: Tool has no model param of its own; BYOM applies only to the host agent's orchestrator. Skips if BING_CONNECTION_ID is unset.
notes: Known bug: first invocation succeeds, every subsequent web-search call in the same agent fails. See test.py for the repro.
